newsitem.title: UK: CE adds to Northern acceptance terms.
newsitem.headline: CE adds to Northern acceptance terms.

text.p: CE Electric UK Plc, controlled by CalEnergy Co Inc of the U.S., on Friday added to the cash settlement terms of its bid for Northern Electric Plc, which closes at 1300 GMT on Friday.
CE Electric said in a statement that acceptances received after the closing date would, assuming the success of its bid, be settled within three days of being received.

The bid has been fought vigorously by Northern and the outcome is regarded in the market as a close call. On Wednesday, CE Electric said that holders of Northern Electric shares who accepted the offer by the closing on Friday would get their cash by no later than Monday.
